# awscc_route53_health_check_source (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Route53::HealthCheckSource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the resource.
- `health_check_source_config` (Attributes) <p>The VPC, subnets, and security groups for the health check source.</p> (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check_source_config))
- `health_check_source_id` (String) <p>The ID of the health check source. Route 53 assigns this ID when it creates the source.</p>
- `health_check_source_status` (String) <p>The current status of the health check source. The health check source status can have one of the following values:</p>
         <dl>
            <dt>CREATE_PENDING, CREATE_IN_PROGRESS</dt>
            <dd>
               <p>Route 53 is creating the source. Health checks that reference the source don't send requests yet.</p>
            </dd>
            <dt>CREATE_COMPLETED</dt>
            <dd>
               <p>The source is ready to use.</p>
            </dd>
            <dt>CREATE_FAILED</dt>
            <dd>
               <p>Route 53 couldn't create the source. <code>StatusReasonCode</code> and <code>StatusReason</code> explain why.</p>
            </dd>
            <dt>DELETE_PENDING, DELETE_IN_PROGRESS</dt>
            <dd>
               <p>Route 53 is deleting the source.</p>
            </dd>
            <dt>DELETE_COMPLETED</dt>
            <dd>
               <p>Route 53 has deleted the source.</p>
            </dd>
            <dt>DELETE_FAILED</dt>
            <dd>
               <p>Route 53 couldn't delete the source. <code>StatusReasonCode</code> and <code>StatusReason</code> explain why.</p>
            </dd>
         </dl>
         <p>If the status is <code>CREATE_FAILED</code>, delete the source and create a new one. If the status is <code>DELETE_FAILED</code>, retry the <code>DeleteHealthCheckSource</code> request.</p>
- `tags` (Attributes Set) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--health_check_source_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check_source_config`

Read-Only:

- `subnet_configuration_list` (Attributes List) <p>A complex type that contains one <code>SubnetConfiguration</code> element for each Availability Zone that Route 53 uses for private endpoint health checks in the Amazon Web Services Region. Each element must be in a different Availability Zone. Most Regions require three elements. Regions that have only two such Availability Zones, such as US West (N. California), require two elements. Route 53 creates network interfaces in each subnet and sends health check requests from all of them.</p> (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check_source_config--subnet_configuration_list))
- `vpc_id` (String) <p>The ID of the VPC that contains the subnets for the health check source. All subnets in <code>SubnetConfigurationList</code> must belong to this VPC.</p>

<a id="nestedatt--health_check_source_config--subnet_configuration_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check_source_config.subnet_configuration_list`

Read-Only:

- `availability_zone_id` (String) <p>The ID of the Availability Zone that contains the subnet, for example <code>use1-az1</code>. Specify the Availability Zone ID, not the Availability Zone name. Each subnet in a health check source must be in a different Availability Zone.</p>
- `security_group_id_list` (List of String) <p>The IDs of one to ten security groups in the same VPC to associate with the network interfaces that Route 53 creates in this subnet. The security groups must allow outbound traffic to the endpoints that the health checks monitor.</p>
- `subnet_id` (String) <p>The ID of the subnet. The subnet must have free IP addresses for the network interfaces that Route 53 creates.</p>



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.
